meta_title: MJD Local Garden Services | Gardener Birmingham
meta_description: MJD Local Garden Services in Birmingham offers professional garden maintenance, design, and landscaping. Local, reliable, and fully insured. Call today for a free quote.
hero_subhead: Expert garden care in Birmingham. From tidying overgrown borders to complete garden redesigns, we handle it all.
services_subhead: From routine maintenance and hedge trimming to full garden redesigns, we deliver the outdoor space you deserve.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Tidy-Ups
services.desc: Regular weeding, pruning, and grass cutting to keep your garden looking neat year-round. We handle weekly or monthly visits depending on your needs.

services.title: Hedge & Shrub Trimming
services.desc: Professional hedge cutting and shaping to enhance your garden's structure. We clear away clippings and leave everything tidy.

services.title: Lawn Care & Seeding
services.desc: Scarifying, overseeding, and feed programmes to restore tired lawns. Bare patches transformed within weeks into lush, green grass.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Complete garden redesigns, patio laying, raised beds, and planting schemes tailored to your space and budget. We handle the lot from concept to completion.

services.title: Fencing & Decking Installation
services.desc: New fences, decking, and garden structures built to last. We source quality materials and finish with precision.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Waste Removal
services.desc: We tackle overgrown gardens and remove all waste responsibly. No job too big or too messy.

about_pullquote: I started this because I love seeing gardens come alive under proper care.
about_para_1: MJD Local Garden Services has been transforming Birmingham gardens for over 12 years. Founded on a simple principle—that every outdoor space deserves skilled, honest care—we've built a reputation as the gardener locals trust. From family homes in Solihull to period properties across the city, we've completed well over 1000 gardens.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen, deliver on time, and never cut corners. We're fully insured, we tidy as we go, and we price fairly. Whether you need a one-off overhaul or regular fortnightly visits, we treat your garden as if it's our own.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Garden Owners Say About Us

reviews.text: Marcus came out in spring to sort out our overgrown border. What a difference. He knew exactly what to do, worked quickly, and left everything spotless. Best £200 I've spent on the garden. Already booked him in for summer maintenance.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had MJD design and build a new patio with raised beds. Took about three days start to finish. Very professional, friendly lads, and they explained everything as they went. Neighbours have already asked for his number!
reviews.author: Helen M.

reviews.text: We're on a monthly maintenance contract now and honestly can't fault it. Garden looks incredible, tidy cuts, prompt and polite. No faffing about, just proper work. Would happily recommend to anyone.
reviews.author: Robert P.
